lessons.hk-english: yue-only lesson (profile yue.md §8 'add', §4 items 6, 7, 12, 13, 15): Hong Kong English traps — one Cantonese verb vs several English verbs (開/熄, 睇, 帶/攞, 借, 講, 食藥), sentence shapes calqued from Cantonese (I very like, There are many people have, I am difficult to, Although…but, I go first, Wait me), local words that are fine in Hong Kong and unclear abroad (add oil, shroff, chop, lai see, sentence-final particles), and the British (school) / American (this course) word pairs; placed after smalltalk via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck 港式英文陷阱; takes the slot of ko-en's konglish (removed from more/a1.js) and zh-en's chinglish; about half of the check and practice English is reused from zh chinglish, the rest is new; no ko-en counterpart
lessons.articles-3: yue-only lesson (profile yue.md §8 add, §4 item 1): articles revisited at B1, replacing the Korean course's own articles-3 from the scaffold. English side (body rows, checks, practice) converted unchanged from zh-en's articles-3: generic vs specific (no article for generic plurals, uncountables and abstract nouns: Life / Education / Time is…), the with of-/in-phrases and relative clauses, no-article fixed phrases (go to bed, go to work / school, at home / work, in class, by train / bus), the with superlatives and ordinals. Chan 2022 found article errors at every proficiency level in Hong Kong learners' writing, generic reference hardest. ko-en's articles-3 is in ko profile ownLessons, so there is no shared counterpart. Placed after passive (profile.json lessonOrder.after).
